title: Group log CRDT enforces parent existence before append
description: core/group_log/append.rs:86-122: append() verifies all parent CIDs exist in local storage before inserting. Verification is split: append() checks structural invariant (parent existence), verify_entry() checks cryptographic invariant (signature + HLC monotonicity). A contributor might suggest 'simplifying' by deferring parent checks to reconciliation — resist this. Deferring allows phantom parent chains to enter local storage and propagate to peers before being caught.
